hooks.name: Auto-activate deploy-to-vercel skill
hooks.description: Reminds Kiro to activate the deploy-to-vercel skill on any turn that involves deploying to Vercel.

action.prompt: If this turn will interact with Vercel in any way (deploying, redeploying, promoting a deployment, creating a preview, aliasing, invoking the Vercel CLI or Vercel REST API, or the user mentions "vercel", "deploy", "desplegar", "despliegue", "redespliegue", "preview", "promote"): before running any deploy commands or Vercel API calls, activate the `deploy-to-vercel` skill via `disclose_context` with name="deploy-to-vercel". Then follow the skill's Step 1 (Gather Project State) and Step 2 (Choose Deploy Method) flow. If `disclose_context` for `deploy-to-vercel` has already returned in this session, do not re-activate.
